state.emptyDay: No visits today. Tap an open slot to book one.
state.noBarbersBody: Add your team under Barbers and a column will show up here for every chair.
state.readOnly: You can only view the schedule. Ask for permission to edit it.

move.remindersCancelled: We cancelled the old reminder; it gets rescheduled for the new time.

modal.noResults: No matches. You can add them below.
modal.servicesEmpty: You don't have any services in the catalog yet.
modal.notesPlaceholder: Number 2 on the sides, part on the left…
modal.priceFrozen: The price is locked in at booking: even if the catalog goes up, this visit keeps its price.
modal.durationAuto: Worked out from the services you picked. You can change it.
modal.durationManual: Custom duration: this one wins over the catalog.
modal.durationResetTitle: Go back to the {min} min the services add up to

detail.title: Visit
detail.durationHint: Stretch or shorten the visit without rebooking it. If it ends up overlapping the same barber's next visit, it won't save and we'll tell you why.
detail.chargeSkipHint: Paying later? You can close without charging; the visit stays under “Visits to charge” in the register.

schedule.title: Hours and time off
schedule.subtitle: What you set here is what the schedule offers: outside these hours nothing can be booked.
schedule.splitHint: Closing for lunch? Add two shifts to the same day (say 9:00–14:00 and 16:00–20:00).
schedule.noBarber: Pick a barber to edit their hours.

timeOff.title: Schedule blocks
timeOff.subtitle: Lunch breaks, vacations and holidays. While a block is on, those slots are never offered.
timeOff.reasonPlaceholder: Lunch, a wedding, a long weekend…

trapped.one: Heads up: {count} visit fell inside this block. Move it or cancel it.
trapped.other: Heads up: {count} visits fell inside this block. Move them or cancel them.

queue.title: Virtual queue
queue.subtitle: Whoever walks in signs up, sees their spot and stops asking how much longer.
queue.name: Name
queue.phoneHint: With WhatsApp you can ping them when they're almost up.
queue.emptyHint: Stick the QR next to the register and whoever walks in signs up from their phone.
queue.serveBody: This creates an IN-CHAIR visit with this barber, so the checkout and the commission come from it.

notify.queued: Ping recorded. It goes out as soon as WhatsApp is connected.
notify.already: There was already a ping queued for this person.
notify.noPhone: That person didn't leave a WhatsApp number.
notify.explain: This version RECORDS the ping; sending it over WhatsApp is wired up by the next wave.

qr.title: Counter QR
qr.body: Print it and stick it next to the register. Whoever walks in scans it, signs up and watches their spot live.

public.title: Sign up from your phone
public.subtitle: Leave your name and check your spot without asking anyone.
public.name: Your name
public.phoneHint: We only use it to ping you when you're almost up.

waitingNow.other: There are {count} people waiting right now

public.empty: No queue right now. Come on in.
public.etaNote: It's an estimate based on the shop's average. It can shift.
public.calledBody: Head to the chair, they're waiting for you.
public.left: We took you out of the queue. If you're still here, let the counter know.
public.closedBody: Ask at the counter and they'll gladly sign you up.

errors.name: Type your name.
errors.generic: We couldn't sign you up. Try again.

charge.title: Charge {client}'s visit
charge.noSessionBody: Today's money goes into a shift, and there isn't one open right now. Open it with the starting cash and we'll go on with the charge.
charge.notPendingTitle: This visit isn't in the list of visits to charge
charge.notPendingBody: The register only lists completed visits from the last few days with no receipt yet. If this one is older, charge it from the Register screen.
